description: An engineering manager must finalize the remediation plan for a production incident involving duplicate payment-webhook deliveries, with input from the on-call SRE and the customer-support lead.

shared_context.S1: On Tuesday, the payment-webhook service delivered duplicate notifications for 26 minutes after a retry configuration change.
shared_context.S2: The retry configuration change is currently recorded as the immediate cause in the incident draft.
shared_context.S3: Riley is responsible for approving the final postmortem remediation plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal incident-review routine, Riley asks the on-call SRE and the customer-support lead in turn for any findings that should change the remediation plan before it is finalized.

PF1.text: While tracing a separate timeout alert this morning, Omar found that the retry worker bypasses the payment provider's idempotency key on its timeout path, so a future timeout can still create duplicate deliveries even if the retry configuration change is reverted; he has not filed the finding in the incident tracker yet. The remediation plan must include an idempotency-remediation commitment for the payment-webhook-retry-worker and a duplicate-delivery replay test that verifies the idempotency fix prevents duplicates under timeout conditions.

PF2.text: While handling follow-up tickets, Maya confirmed that exactly two enterprise customers received duplicate payment notifications, and their contracts require a written incident summary within 3 business days of an incident; she has not updated the incident channel because she was waiting for the support ticket details to be reconciled. The remediation plan must commit to notifying these two enterprise customers and must include a customer-incident-summary commitment for them within the 3-business-day contractual deadline.

acceptance_conditions: The timeout path must enforce the payment provider's idempotency key.
A duplicate-delivery replay test must be required before the remediation is closed.
The written incident summary must be due within 3 business days of the incident.
Both affected enterprise customers must be notified.
The plan must include an idempotency-remediation commitment for the retry worker.
The plan must include a customer-incident-summary commitment for the two affected enterprise customers.
Omar's finding about the timeout-path idempotency bypass must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'idempotency_remediation' and c['target'] == 'payment-webhook-retry-worker' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'customer_incident_summary' and c['target'] == 'two affected enterprise customers' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The recorded configuration cause alone does not require timeout-path idempotency enforcement, a duplicate-delivery replay test, or an idempotency-remediation commitment; PF1 changes those choices to require all three.
Without PF2, the plan has no basis for a 3-business-day written-summary deadline, notification of the two affected enterprise customers, or a customer-incident-summary commitment for them.
